Name: L5
Details: -- DECISION LOG - INDEX STRATEGY:

Name: L7
Details: --   INDEX RULE: Every index speeds up reads but SLOWS writes

Name: L8
Details: --   (PostgreSQL must update the index on every INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE).

Name: L9
Details: --   Each index below has a documented query justification.

Name: L10
Details: --   We do NOT index every column - only those in WHERE, JOIN ON,

Name: L11
Details: --   and ORDER BY clauses of the TOP 10 hottest queries.

Name: L13
Details: --   [I1] idx_slots_room_day_period (COMPOSITE, B-TREE)

Name: L14
Details: --        Query: "Is room A201 free on Wednesday period 3?"

Name: L15
Details: --        SELECT * FROM timetable_slots

Name: L16
Details: --        WHERE room_id = ? AND day_of_week = ? AND period_number = ?

Name: L17
Details: --        Without index: full seq scan of ~50,000 rows (all slots all semesters).

Name: L18
Details: --        With index: binary search -> ~log2(50000) = 16 comparisons.

Name: L19
Details: --        Column order matters: room_id first (highest cardinality = most selective).

Name: L20
Details: --        Adding version_id: lets WHERE version_id = ? use the same index.

Name: L22
Details: --   [I2] idx_exam_seats_student_exam (COMPOSITE, B-TREE)

Name: L23
Details: --        Query: "Show my exam seat" - runs on EVERY student login.

Name: L24
Details: --        Peak load: all students check simultaneously after exam publish.
